retisin.name: Demo Product 1 (DEMO-01)
retisin.description: From a molecular biology perspective, Retisin targets the fundamental restoration of cellular energetics and immune surveillance. Its primary benefit is the modulation of the organism's 'terrain' – optimizing the environment for regenerative processes. It acts as a strong roborant (strengthening agent), historically proven to increase the organism's overall resistance and suppress fermentative processes (often associated with the Warburg effect in pathological tissues) in favor of oxidative metabolism. It is ideal for states of exhaustion, convalescence after invasive procedures or radiotherapy, and for supporting hematopoiesis.

origin.title: Origin and Production
origin.description: Deproteinized ethanol extract from bovine tissue with a specific spectrum of low-molecular bioactive substances.

source.title: Bovine Tissue
source.description: Obtained from certified organic farms with strict quality control.

production.title: Extraction
production.description: Specific ethanol extraction preserving low-molecular bioactive substances.

energy.title: Cellular Energy Restoration
energy.description: Targets fundamental restoration of cellular energetics and optimization of metabolic processes.

immunity.title: Immune Surveillance
immunity.description: Modulates the organism's 'terrain' and optimizes the environment for regenerative processes.

resistance.title: Increased Resistance
resistance.description: Historically proven increase in overall organism resistance and suppression of fermentative processes.

recovery.title: Convalescence
recovery.description: Ideal for exhaustion, after invasive procedures or radiotherapy, and for supporting hematopoiesis.

substances.nucleotides: Free nucleotides and nucleosides (AMP, CMP, GMP, IMP, UMP) - essential for DNA/RNA synthesis and energy (ATP)
substances.peptides: Bioactive peptides and oligopeptides (defensins, hemocidins) with immunomodulatory function
substances.aminoAcids: Spectrum of free amino acids and derivatives (taurine) for neuroendocrine regulation

application.title: Application
application.description: Orally. Application under the tongue is recommended for rapid absorption through the mucosa and bypassing liver metabolism (first-pass effect). Form: 30ml drops (solution).

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.description: Standard productation involves 1–2 ml daily (approx. 20–40 drops), ideally on an empty stomach or away from food to maximize absorption of peptide components.

chronic.title: Long-term Use
chronic.description: Suitable for long-term use in cycles (e.g., 3 months use, 1 month break) to maintain receptor sensitivity.

floristen.name: Demo Product 2 (DEMO-02)
floristen.description: Floristen represents a unique approach to phytotherapy for chronic inflammation. Unlike common St. John's Wort extracts, this tool is designed to eliminate phototoxic components and maximize non-specific anti-inflammatory effects. The mechanism involves inhibiting proliferative inflammatory processes and supporting the resorption of infiltrates (inflammatory foci). Historically proven in chronic gynecological inflammations and conditions resistant to antibiotic treatment, acting as a "herbal shield" and supporting tissue vascularization.

origin.title: Origin and Production
origin.description: Specifically prepared hydroalcoholic extract from Hypericum perforatum (St. John's Wort), focusing on the water-soluble fraction.

production.title: Selective Extraction
production.description: Elimination of phototoxic components, maximization of non-specific anti-inflammatory effect.

antiInflammatory.title: Anti-inflammatory Effect
antiInflammatory.description: Maximized non-specific anti-inflammatory effect, inhibition of proliferative inflammatory processes.

resorption.title: Resorption Support
resorption.description: Support for resorption of infiltrates (inflammatory foci).

shield.title: Herbal Shield
shield.description: Acts as a herbal shield in chronic conditions and supports tissue vascularization.

safety.title: Safety
safety.description: Designed to eliminate phototoxic components common in St. John's Wort extracts.

substances.flavonoids: Flavonoids (quercetin, rutin, hyperoside, amentoflavone) - strong antioxidant activity, inflammation modulation
substances.phloroglucinols: Phloroglucinols (limited, modified hyperforin/adhyperforin) - preserved antimicrobial potential, minimized interactions
substances.naphthodianthrones: Naphthodianthrones (limited, minimized hypericin) - reduced photosensitivity risk, preserved antiviral potential

application.title: Application
application.description: Orally, mixed in a small amount of water or applied directly. Form: 30ml drops (solution).

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.description: Standard 20–30 drops 2–3× daily. For chronic conditions, long-term administration (minimum 6–8 weeks) is key for tissue saturation with flavonoids.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: Although the extract is modified, caution is recommended during sun exposure and consultation with a doctor when taking immunosuppressants or hormonal contraceptives.

lyastin.name: Demo Product 3 (DEMO-03)
lyastin.description: Lyastin targets the integrity of cell membranes and microcirculation. Its main benefit is improving the nutrition (trophics) of ischemic tissues and supporting the regeneration of vascular endothelium. It works by supplying essential building blocks for cell wall repair, acting as a vasodilator and spasmolytic. It is indicated for supporting peripheral circulation, regeneration after vascular events, and conditions associated with tissue degeneration due to hypoxia (lack of oxygen).

origin.title: Origin and Production
origin.description: Ethanol-ether extract from bovine tissue focusing on the lipid fraction.

membrane.title: Membrane Integrity
membrane.description: Targets cell membrane integrity and supplies building blocks for repair.

circulation.title: Microcirculation and Trophics
circulation.description: Improving nutrition of ischemic tissues, supporting vascular endothelium regeneration.

vasodilation.title: Vasodilation
vasodilation.description: Acts as a vasodilator and spasmolytic.

indications.title: Indications
indications.description: Support for peripheral circulation, regeneration after vascular events, conditions associated with hypoxia.

substances.phospholipids: Phospholipids (phosphatidylcholines, sphingomyelins, phosphoethanolamines) - critical for membrane fluidity and function
substances.lipoproteins: Lipoproteins and sterols - support lipid transport and membrane stability
substances.fattyAcids: Fatty acids (optimized n-3 and n-6 ratio) - regulation of inflammatory response at membrane level

application.title: Application
application.description: Orally. Due to lipid nature, it is advisable to take with food containing fats for better absorption, or directly. Form: 30ml drops (solution).

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.description: 1–2 ml daily (approx. 20–40 drops). For conditions requiring intensive tissue regeneration (e.g., post-traumatic states, bedsores), distribution can be increased short-term.

synergy.title: Combination
synergy.description: Historically shows strong synergy with Floristen (for inflammatory and necrotic processes).

rtnDuo.name: Demo Product 4 (Demo Product 1 + Demo Product 2)
rtnDuo.description: This combined tool utilizes synergy between metabolic stimulation (Retisin) and anti-inflammatory shield (Floristen). While Retisin supplies 'fuel' and signaling molecules for immune cells (nucleotides, peptides), Floristen modulates the inflammatory environment and reduces oxidative stress. The spray form allows rapid application via oral mucosa, ensuring immediate availability for mucosal immunity (IgA) and systemic circulation. Ideal for acute immune support, at first signs of virosis, or as prevention during stressful periods.

origin.title: Origin and Composition
origin.description: Combination of bioactive spectra of both parental tools (Retisin + Floristen) in spray form.

source.title: Combined Source
source.description: Nucleoprotein fraction from Retisin and flavonoid fraction from Floristen.

production.title: Synergistic Formulation
production.description: Spray form for maximum bioavailability and immediate mucosal absorption.

synergy.title: Synergistic Effect
synergy.description: Combination supports oxygen utilization in tissues and simultaneously suppresses pathological proliferation.

metabolic.title: Metabolic Support
metabolic.description: Supplies 'fuel' and signaling molecules for immune cells (from Retisin).

inflammation.title: Inflammation Modulation
inflammation.description: Modulates inflammatory environment and reduces oxidative stress (from Floristen).

absorption.title: Rapid Absorption
absorption.description: Spray allows rapid application via mucosa, bypassing digestive tract and degradation.

substances.nucleoproteins: Nucleoprotein fraction (from Retisin) - DNA regeneration, protein synthesis in immune cells
substances.flavonoids: Flavonoid fraction (from Floristen) - quercetin and rutin for capillary stabilization and free radical scavenging
substances.complex: Synergistic Complex - strong regenerative and defense effect

application.title: Application
application.description: Sublingually (under tongue) or on throat mucosa using sprayer. Shake before use. Form: 30ml spray (combined solution).

distribution.title: Distribution
distribution.description: Preventive: 3–5 sprays 2× daily. Acute support: 5 sprays every 3–4 hours during first days of load.

note.title: Note
note.description: Spray form is designed for maximum compliance and bioavailability, bypassing degradation in digestive tract.
